name: Authority
description: One person directing another, or heading an organization or department.

relation.reads: Linda is Kevin's manager — the one in charge is the subject
relation.notes: Often recorded against a body rather than a person: whoever heads a department is linked to the department, not to each of its members. Reading one from the other is a step for whoever is asking.
relation.how_many: One manager at a time on the report's end: that is what the word means, and a second one for the same stretch is a handover. Nothing is limited on the manager's end — a manager has as many reports as they have.
